# Rohit Pandey - Software Engineer & Full-Stack Developer

> Rohit Pandey is a B.Tech Computer Engineering student at Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering (2025–2029) in Mumbai, building full-stack applications, AI-assisted developer tools, and competitive-programming telemetry systems.

Website: https://rohit-pandey10.vercel.app/
GitHub: https://github.com/Rohit-Pandey10
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/rohit-pandey-964b1036a/
Email: rohitpdev@gmail.com

This file is a concise, machine-readable overview of Rohit's portfolio. It includes the technical context an agent needs to understand the projects and the direct resources to consult for deeper details.

**Professional summary:** Full-stack software engineer focused on scalable backend systems, responsive React applications, AI/LLM developer tooling, REST API design, and problem solving. Experienced with the MERN stack, PostgreSQL, Docker, Vercel Serverless, MongoDB Atlas, and remote LaTeX compilation pipelines.

**Education:** Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.) in Computer Engineering at Dwarkadas J. Sanghvi College of Engineering, Mumbai, India; 2025–2029; CGPA 9.45/10.0.

**Core technical proficiencies:**

- **Languages:** C++, Python, JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, SQL, C, Java
- **Frontend:** React 18/19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, HTML5, CSS3, client-side state management, web performance optimization
- **Backend and systems:** Node.js, Express.js, RESTful architecture, MVC, microservice proxying, authentication, JWT, bcrypt
- **Databases and ORMs:** MongoDB Atlas, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Mongoose
- **DevOps and cloud:** Docker, Vercel Edge/Serverless, Git, GitHub Actions, Linux/macOS environments
- **Developer tooling and formats:** LaTeX, `pdflatex`, Overleaf, Postman, VS Code, Markdown, JSON Schema

**Featured engineering context:**

- **BrandLoom — AI Brand Strategy & Marketing Platform:** A MERN and Tailwind application with an adaptive Socratic founder interview engine, Groq Llama 3.3 70B as the primary LLM, Gemini as a fallback, MongoDB Atlas with automatic local-JSON fallback, and a prompt-engineering layer that produces personalized brand kits. The system was shipped in a 24-hour hackathon environment.
- **JakeResume — ATS LaTeX Resume Platform:** A React, Node.js, Express, Tailwind CSS, and LaTeX platform that converts structured profile data into ATS-friendly documents. It includes deterministic LaTeX character and macro sanitization, client-side reactive generation, typed LLM ingestion, a 48-line page-budget estimator, and a three-tier compilation flow using an Express proxy, remote `pdflatex`, client-side `.tex` generation, and Overleaf dispatch.
- **Personal Portfolio & CP Aggregator:** A React/Vite frontend with a Node.js/Express backend and MongoDB cache. It uses decoupled platform services for Codeforces, LeetCode, CodeChef, and AtCoder, `Promise.allSettled` aggregation, a 15-minute MongoDB cache policy, stale-cache and hardcoded fallbacks, and `public, s-maxage=3600, stale-while-revalidate=86400` response caching for CP statistics. Live stats can be injected into LaTeX source for on-demand resume PDF compilation.

**Competitive programming context:** Rohit actively practices graphs, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, number theory, and general data structures and algorithms.

- **Codeforces:** handle `Rohit.Pandey`; rating 1109; maximum rating 1199.
- **LeetCode:** handle `Rohit_Pandey10`; 80+ problems solved; contest rating is exposed by the live CP telemetry API when available.
- **CodeChef:** handle `rohit_pandey10`; rating 1406; maximum rating 1426; DSA rating 1508.
- **AtCoder:** participation telemetry contributes to the aggregate contest count; AtCoder is intentionally not rendered as a rating card or profile button in the portfolio UI.
